title: VA Tele-Hearing Modernization Act
official_summary:
VA Tele-Hearing Modernization Act

This bill authorizes appellants in cases before the Board of Veterans' Appeals to appear at a hearing by picture and voice transmission (e.g., Skype) from locations other than Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) facilities. The bill requires the VA to report specified statistics and information related to hearings held by picture and voice transmission.

summary.headline: This law lets people appealing VA decisions before the Board of Veterans' Appeals attend hearings by video or audio from locations other than VA facilities.
summary.what_it_does: The law allows appellants in cases before the Board of Veterans' Appeals to appear at a hearing using picture and voice transmission, such as Skype, from places other than Department of Veterans Affairs facilities. It also requires the VA to report specified statistics and information about hearings held this way.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans and other appellants with cases before the Board of Veterans' Appeals
who_it_affects.how: They may take part in a hearing by picture and voice transmission from a location outside a VA facility instead of only in person at one.
The VA must report specified statistics and information about hearings held by picture and voice transmission.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The summary does not state an effective date; the law was enacted on April 10, 2020.
